conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const body = $json.body; if (!['opened','reopened','labeled','assigned'].includes(body.action)) return false; if (body.sender && body.sender.type === 'Bot') return false; const botLogins = ($env.N8N_BOT_LOGINS || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean); if (botLogins.includes(body.sender && body.sender.login)) return false; const labels = (body.issue.labels || []).map(l => l.name); if (labels.includes('agent-task')) return true; let map = {}; try { map = JSON.parse($env.N8N_AGENT_MAP || '{}'); } catch (e) { return false; } const assignees = (body.issue.assignees || []).map(a => a.login); return assignees.some(a => map[a] && map[a].role === 'implementer'); })() }}

parameters.command:
=set +e
set -o pipefail
BRANCH="agent/issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }}"
cd ~/workspace || exit 10
_URL=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null)
_T="${_URL#*x-access-token:}"
export GH_TOKEN="${_T%%@*}"
git fetch origin main 2>&1
git checkout -B "$BRANCH" origin/main 2>&1
echo {{ $json.promptB64 }} | base64 -d > /tmp/prompt-{{ $json.issueNumber }}.txt
claude --print < /tmp/prompt-{{ $json.issueNumber }}.txt
CLAUDE_RC=$?
rm -f /tmp/prompt-{{ $json.issueNumber }}.txt
echo "CLAUDE_RC=$CLAUDE_RC"
if git diff --quiet origin/main..HEAD; then
  echo "PR_URL="
  echo "ERROR: no changes produced by claude" >&2
  exit 0
fi
git push -u origin "$BRANCH" --force 2>&1
PUSH_RC=$?
echo "PUSH_RC=$PUSH_RC"
if [ $PUSH_RC -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "PR_URL="
  exit 0
fi
EXISTING=$(gh pr list --head "$BRANCH" --state open --json url --jq '.[0].url' 2>&1)
if [ -n "$EXISTING" ] && [ "${EXISTING#https://}" != "$EXISTING" ]; then
  echo "PR_URL=$EXISTING"
  echo "reused existing PR"
  exit 0
fi
GH_OUT=$(gh pr create --fill --base main --head "$BRANCH" --label ai-generated --reviewer "{{ $json.reviewerLogin }}" 2>&1)
GH_RC=$?
echo "GH_RC=$GH_RC"
echo "GH_OUT<<__END__"
echo "$GH_OUT"
echo "__END__"
PR_URL=$(printf '%s\n' "$GH_OUT" | grep -Eo 'https://github.com/[^ ]+/pull/[0-9]+' | tail -1)
echo "PR_URL=$PR_URL"
exit 0
